entries.german: verpflichtet sich, dem Ulrich v. Rosenberg die ihm rücksichtlich seiner Dienste u. des hiebei erlittenen Schadens schuldige Summe v. 3500 Schock böhm. Groschen in bestimmten Raten zu bezahlen. Ad m. d. r. Michael prepos. Boleslav. ─ R. Henricus Fye.
entries.english: He undertakes to pay Ulrich von Rosenberg, in specified instalments, the sum of 3,500 shock of Bohemian groschen owed to him in respect of his services and the damage he suffered in them. By mandate of the Roman king; Michael, provost of Boleslav. Register entry: Henricus Fye.
